purpose: Optional high-resolution terrain: the park as a residual over heightfield.json's 20.48 m grid, at 10.00 m and 5.00 m. One rectangle, one codec, one level downloaded at a time - whichever the quality control asks for.
rowOrientation: row 0 = north edge (ymax); row N-1 = south edge (ymin)

encoding.meaning: a signed elevation CORRECTION in metres, to be ADDED to the bilinear value of heightfield.json at the same world point
encoding.zeroOutsideBbox: The correction is zero everywhere outside bboxCrsUnits, and is faded to exactly zero over each level's outermost pixels, so the tier adds detail without moving the surface at its edge.
encoding.sharedAcrossLevels: One half-range for every level, because the GLSL decoder is generated once from the constant in src/heighttier.js and cannot switch mappings per level. The coarser level spends a little precision it does not need; its steps stay far finer than the base grid's own 0.07 m.

sources.name: DTM0508_002_UNICO (Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta)
sources.coverage: Valle d'Aosta side of the park - highest quality. The source ASC is 2.0 m/px (DEM/pngp_extraction_report.txt); extract-heightmap.sh resamples it to this grid, so 'native' here means the target resolution, not the source's.
